project_title: TelePulse Ad Engine - Telegram Group Campaign Automation Dashboard

theme_strategy.rationale: Telegram power-users and broadcast automation operators work in continuous monitoring environments where high-density dark dashboards reduce eye fatigue and maximize high-visibility status signals.

visual_enhancers.telemetry_card: bg-slate-900/90 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 p-5 transition-all duration-200 hover:border-cyan-500/30 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(36,161,222,0.15)]
visual_enhancers.live_pulse: relative inline-flex h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse
visual_enhancers.table_style: w-full text-left text-sm text-slate-300 border-separate border-spacing-0
visual_enhancers.status_badge_connected: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20
visual_enhancers.status_badge_disconnected: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/20
visual_enhancers.status_badge_running: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/20
visual_enhancers.status_badge_paused: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20

layout_and_grids.app_shell: flex h-screen w-full bg-[#0B0F19] text-slate-100 overflow-hidden font-sans
layout_and_grids.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 bg-[#090D16] border-r border-slate-800/80 p-4 flex flex-col justify-between hidden md:flex
layout_and_grids.main_content: flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 overflow-y-auto p-4 md:p-8 space-y-8
layout_and_grids.stats_overview_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

component_architecture.file_structure_convention: JavaScript (.js and .jsx files) using React 19, Lucide React icons, Sonner toasts, and Recharts.

key_components.name: HeaderNav
key_components.description: Top sticky navigation bar with platform logo, connected account counter, dark/light toggle, quick session test trigger, and live system status.

key_components.name: StatsOverviewCards
key_components.description: 4 key metric cards displaying Total Accounts, Active Campaigns, Total Messages Sent, and Delivery Success Rate with trend badges and Sparkline mini visuals.

key_components.name: AccountsManager
key_components.description: Telethon String Session management modal and card list. Form inputs for Account Name, API ID, API Hash, Telethon Session String with instant 'Validate Session' and connection test capabilities.

key_components.name: TargetDialogSelectorModal
key_components.description: Dialog list modal with search, category filters (Groups, Supergroups, Channels), multi-select checkboxes, subscriber counts, and Telethon access verification status.

key_components.name: CampaignCreatorWizard
key_components.description: Multi-step or rich unified builder supporting: Message Mode (Text, Text + Image/Media URL, Forward Post), Live Message Preview box, Target Group Selection list, and Repeat Interval Scheduler (minutes/hours).

key_components.name: CampaignDashboardList
key_components.description: Interactive list of created campaigns with Start/Stop toggle switches, detailed execution progress bar, target group tags, repeat interval indicator, and next scheduled run countdown.

key_components.name: ActivityLogsTable
key_components.description: Filterable real-time activity execution log table with search, status filters (Success, Failed, Pending), Telethon account tag, target group link, timestamp, and detailed response error details.

key_components.name: SessionTesterWidget
key_components.description: Interactive playground tool allowing users to test Telethon string session connections or send a test ping message directly to a personal group or test chat.

testing_attributes_convention.mandatory_rule: All interactive elements, input fields, filter tabs, table rows, and status indicators MUST include explicit role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components matching existing project setup.
Construct a dark tactical dashboard using deep obsidian background (#0B0F19) and subtle slate glass card layers (#111827).

Ensure all 7 key user functionalities are fully interactive and connected to mock or live backend state: Telethon Account Management, Group Fetching & Selector, Ad Campaign Builder with live message preview, Campaign Dashboard with start/stop toggles & countdowns, Send Logs table with real-time log filter, Stats Cards, and Telethon session verification test tool.
Implement Sonner toasts for instant feedback on account validation, campaign toggles, and message dispatching.
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML select boxes; use Shadcn components or custom dark styled dropdowns.
Strictly follow data-testid conventions for all buttons, inputs, tabs, and status cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, glassmorphic strokes (border-slate-800/80), live pulse status indicators, custom scrollbars, and high-visibility stats hierarchy. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
